# Cris Nguyen Knowledge OS

> AI-First Knowledge Graph & Portfolio Platform. High-density, machine-readable structured knowledge system for modern engineering practices, Next.js architecture, NestJS backend patterns, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and autonomous AI agents.

## Overview
Cris Nguyen Knowledge OS exposes structured knowledge entities (Topics, Skills, MCP Servers, AI Agents, Architectures, Projects, Prompts) via interactive web interfaces, REST APIs (/api/v1/...), and standard JSON-LD / LLM discovery protocols.

## Core Navigation & Pages
- [/](https://crisne.blog/): Home portfolio & Knowledge OS entrypoint
- [/knowledge](https://crisne.blog/knowledge): Knowledge Graph & Entity Index
- [/topics](https://crisne.blog/topics): Technical Topics & Deep Dives
- [/skills](https://crisne.blog/skills): Executable Micro-skills & Code Patterns
- [/mcps](https://crisne.blog/mcps): Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers Registry
- [/agents](https://crisne.blog/agents): Autonomous AI Agent Specifications
- [/projects](https://crisne.blog/projects): Real-world Project Architectures & Implementations
- [/architectures](https://crisne.blog/architectures): System Architecture Blueprint Models

## Core Knowledge OS APIs
All API endpoints return JSON conforming to standard Knowledge OS schemas (`success`, `data`, `meta`).

- `GET /api/v1/topics`: Query and filter knowledge entities by type, tag, category, difficulty, or search query.
- `GET /api/v1/topics/[slug]`: Fetch full entity details and graph relationships by slug or ID.
- `GET /api/v1/skills`: List executable skills and pattern recipes.
- `GET /api/v1/mcps`: Fetch Model Context Protocol server specs and tools.
- `GET /api/v1/agents`: Inspect AI Agent roles, system prompts, and tool configurations.
- `GET /api/v1/graph`: Graph dataset containing nodes and edges connecting topics, skills, MCPs, agents, and projects.
- `GET /api/v1/recommendations?topic=[slug]`: Adaptive learning path generator for AI agents and developers.
